capabilities.name: Alert Creation and Score Thresholding
capabilities.notes: Scores 0.0-1.0 mapped to risk_score (0-1000) and severity levels.

capabilities.name: Sliding-Window Alert Deduplication
capabilities.notes: 5-minute sliding window aggregates duplicate alerts and escalates risk.

capabilities.name: Shared Threat Intelligence Exchange
capabilities.notes: HMAC-SHA256 salted entity hashing prevents raw PII leakage across institutions.

capabilities.name: Case Creation with 24h Request Idempotency
capabilities.notes: Idempotency key bounded 24h in Redis with SHA-256 canonical payload mismatch check.

capabilities.name: Cryptographic Hash-Chained Investigation Timeline
capabilities.notes: Tamper-evident parent-hash chained timeline prevents silent history rewrites.

capabilities.name: Four-Eyes Dual Control (Maker-Checker)
capabilities.notes: Strictly enforces ApproverID != InvestigatorID and requires 2 distinct supervisor signatures for terminal closure.

capabilities.name: Terminal Case Immutability (Replay Resistance)
capabilities.notes: CLOSED_CONFIRMED and CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE cases cannot be transitioned, reassigned, or linked.

capabilities.name: Optimistic Concurrency Control
capabilities.notes: Returns HTTP 409 Conflict if current state does not match expected_status, preventing lost updates.

capabilities.name: FinCEN BSA SAR 2.0 XML Generation
capabilities.notes: Produces valid FinCEN SAR 2.0 XML with SHA-256 seal. Rejects unreviewed/false positive cases.

capabilities.name: Direct Regulator FIU Electronic Gateway Transmission
capabilities.notes: System generates, signs, and exports SAR packages locally. Real-world FinCEN batch SDX gateway requires federal batch credentials.

capabilities.name: UNODC goAML XML Export
capabilities.notes: Generates international standard goAML XML for UNODC jurisdictions.

capabilities.name: ISO 20022 Financial Messaging XML (pacs.008, pacs.002, camt.053)
capabilities.notes: Compliant interbank payment message validation and error reporting.

capabilities.name: Developer Webhook Notification Gateway
capabilities.notes: SSRF-hardened fail-closed dispatch with deterministic stable event IDs for replay deduplication.

capabilities.name: Agentic AML Copilot Investigation Assistant
capabilities.notes: Zero-PII narrative synthesis from graph topology, SHAP drivers, and timeline events.

capabilities.name: Evidence Registry with SHA-256 Integrity Verification
capabilities.notes: Registers uploaded evidence artifacts with cryptographic digest.

capabilities.name: Canonical Demo Cases (CASE-98492, CASE-2026-001, CASE-2026-004)
capabilities.notes: Preserved strictly for guided demonstration flows. Arbitrary non-existent UUIDs return 404.

capabilities.name: Case Merging / Linking
capabilities.notes: Cases can link multiple alerts, but merging two existing cases is not supported.

capabilities.name: Automated Human Decision Model Retraining Pipeline
capabilities.notes: Human case resolutions do not automatically feed back into training labels, preventing training set poisoning.
